emergency.en: This may be an emergency. Go to the nearest health facility now. If you cannot travel, call your CHW or the emergency number right away.
emergency.tw: Eyi betumi ayɛ ahohia. Kɔ ayaresabea a ɛbɛn wo ho nnɛ. Sɛ wontumi nantew a, frɛ wo CHW anaa ahohia nɔma nnɛ.

visit_date.en: Your next clinic visit is on the date your CHW gave you. Please come. If you do not know the date, ask your CHW.
visit_date.tw: Wo clinic nsɔhwɛ a edi hɔ no yɛ da a wo CHW kyerɛɛ wo. Sɛ wonnim da no a, bisa wo CHW.

transport.en: If transport is a problem, tell your CHW. Your CHW can help you plan a ride to the facility.
transport.tw: Sɛ akwantu yɛ ɔhaw a, ka kyerɛ wo CHW. Wo CHW betumi aboa wo ma wonhyehyɛ akwantu.

feeding.en: For feeding questions, your CHW will help. Ask them to show you an approved feeding plan for your baby.
feeding.tw: Sɛ w'abisa nneɛma a wɔde bɛma abofra no ho a, wo CHW bɛboa wo. Bisa no sɛ ɔnkyerɛ wo nnuane a wɔapene so.

unknown.en: Sorry, I did not understand. Please call your CHW, or ask a family member to call them for you.
unknown.tw: Me ho ayɛ wo, minnte nea woka no. Frɛ wo CHW, anaa ka sɛ obi nfrɛ wɔn ma wo.
